title: rorca-context-intent-engine
_philosophy: Context is 'The Is' (Ontology) — defines the world, constraints, state. Intent is 'The Ought' (Teleology) — defines goals, pressure to change. These are distinct computational layers. The engine routes context surgically and deterministically, never scattering files or pushing all context into every prompt.

userStories.title: rorca init — Workspace Echolocation and Stack Detection
userStories.description: When a workspace is registered or 'rorca init' is run, Rorca scans the project directory to detect the tech stack, existing context/intent files, and scaffolding gaps. Outputs a Workspace Health report.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI command 'rorca init' scans workspace root and subdirectories
Detects tech stack from: package.json (Next.js, React, Express, Prisma, etc.), Cargo.toml (Rust), requirements.txt (Python), go.mod (Go), Dockerfile, .terraform/
Detects presence/absence of: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .rorca/config.json, .rorca/skills/, progress tracking file, MEMORY.md
Computes Context Richness Score (0–100%) based on file presence and content depth
Outputs structured report: { stack: [...], missing: [...], score: 72, suggestions: [...] }
Report surfaced in Hub as 'Workspace Health' card on first registration
Non-destructive — reads only, never writes during echolocation phase
Detects monorepo structure (multiple package.json / apps/ directory) for scope generation

userStories.title: rorca init — Bespoke Scaffold Generation via OpenCode
userStories.description: After echolocation, Rorca offers to generate the full context/intent scaffolding tailored to the detected stack. Uses OpenCode to read the codebase deeply before generating files.
acceptanceCriteria: After health report, UI prompt: 'I detected Next.js + Prisma + TypeScript. Generate context scaffolding?' with preview of files to be created
OpenCode reads actual source files (entry points, schema, routes, components) before generating
Generates bespoke CLAUDE.md (not a template — reflects actual architecture found)
Generates AGENTS.md with roles derived from detected directory structure
Generates .rorca/config.json with path scopes auto-derived from monorepo layout
Generates starter skill files in .rorca/skills/ per detected stack (react.md, prisma.md, etc.)
Preview all generated content in UI before writing — user can edit inline before confirming
One-click write to filesystem after approval
All generated files committed with message 'chore: initialize rorca context/intent scaffolding'

userStories.title: .rorca/ Directory Structure and Config Schema
userStories.description: Establish the canonical .rorca/ directory as the single orchestration home. Define the .rorca/config.json schema covering routing, scopes, tags, token budget, and file registry.
acceptanceCriteria: .rorca/ directory created at workspace root — all Rorca orchestration files live here
.rorca/config.json schema (version, routing, context, teleology sections)
routing.global: array of always-injected files (default: ['CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md'])
routing.scopes: array of { path (glob), inject (skill files), priority (int), managed ('rorca'|'manual'|'hybrid') }
routing.tags: array of { tag (string), inject (skill files) }
routing.tokenBudget: max tokens for injected context per story (default: 8000)
.rorca/skills/ directory for all skill markdown files
.rorca/memory/ directory for episodic memory ledger
.rorca/templates/ directory for project scaffold templates
run-state.json lives at .rorca/run-state.json (replaces progress.txt)
JSON schema file published at .rorca/config.schema.json for IDE validation
backend/src/lib/rorca-config.ts exports typed config loader with zod validation

userStories.title: Virtual Context Routing Engine
userStories.description: The core routing engine that compiles the exact context payload for each story at run time. Uses path-based scoping + tag-based injection + token budget enforcement. Zero physical file scatter.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/src/lib/context-router.ts implements route(story, config, workspacePath) → ContextPayload
ContextPayload: { globals: string[], scoped: string[], tagged: string[], totalTokens: number }
Path matching uses micromatch for glob evaluation against story description + dependsOn paths
Story-start path prediction: parse story description and acceptanceCriteria for file path mentions
Tag matching: story tags array matched against routing.tags rules
Priority resolution: higher priority scope wins on conflict; tag rules are always additive
Token budget enforcement: if compiled context exceeds tokenBudget, drop lowest-priority scoped files first, never drop globals
Token estimation: count tokens via tiktoken-compatible estimator before injection
Context payload written to tmp file, path passed to execution-engine.ts as RORCA_CONTEXT_FILE argument
execution-engine.ts reads RORCA_CONTEXT_FILE and prepends to story prompt before spawning agent subprocess
Unit tests for path matching, priority resolution, token budget enforcement

userStories.title: Episodic MEMORY.md Ledger
userStories.description: Replace freeform MEMORY.md prose with a structured, chronologically-appended decision ledger. Timestamped rules, not narrative. Machine-readable, human-editable.
acceptanceCriteria: MEMORY.md format: chronological entries, each prefixed with date and category

Format: '## YYYY-MM-DD [category] Title
> Rule: ...
> Context: ...
> Source: story-id'
Categories: Architecture, Convention, Bug Fix, Decision, Pattern, Gotcha
backend/src/lib/memory-ledger.ts: append(entry), query(category), recent(n) functions
Post-run synthesis: after each run, Claude/OpenCode reviews story diffs and proposes new ledger entries
Proposed entries surfaced in Hub as 'Memory Updates' card — user approves/rejects/edits each
Rejected entries logged but not written (stored in .rorca/memory/rejected.json)
MEMORY.md remains human-readable Markdown — no binary format
Context router injects most recent N entries (configurable, default: 20) as part of global context
In-app MEMORY.md editor with entry-level management (delete, edit, categorize)

userStories.title: AGENTS.md as Soft Governance Layer
userStories.description: AGENTS.md defines agent roles, file ownership, and behavioral constraints as soft governance — injected into every story prompt so agents know their boundaries. Not hard filesystem enforcement (v1).
acceptanceCriteria: AGENTS.md schema: roles array, each with name, owns (glob patterns), avoids (glob patterns), rules (string[])
Example: { name: 'Frontend Agent', owns: ['src/components/**', 'src/pages/**'], avoids: ['backend/**', 'db/**'], rules: ['Never introduce new npm packages without listing alternatives'] }
Rorca parses AGENTS.md and injects role constraints into story prompt context
backend/src/lib/agents-parser.ts parses AGENTS.md, returns typed AgentRole[]
Story assignment: Rorca infers which agent role applies based on story description and paths
Assigned role's owns/avoids/rules injected into story prompt
Violation detection (post-run): after story commits, scan changed files against assigned role's avoids — surface warning in Hub if violated
In-app AGENTS.md editor with role cards (name, owned paths, avoided paths, rules list)
Generated AGENTS.md from echolocation reflects actual directory structure found

userStories.title: run-state.json — Typed Event Ledger (replaces progress.txt)
userStories.description: Replace progress.txt freeform text with .rorca/run-state.json — a strictly-typed event ledger enabling deterministic run resumption.
acceptanceCriteria: .rorca/run-state.json schema: { specId, runId, startedAt, lastUpdatedAt, completedStories: [], failedStories: [], skippedStories: [], currentStory, decisions: [] }
decisions: array of { storyId, timestamp, type, description } — mid-run decisions the agent recorded
Written atomically after each story completes (tmp file rename, never partial write)
execution-engine.ts reads .rorca/run-state.json on resume — knows exactly which story to restart from
On run complete: run-state.json archived to .rorca/memory/runs/{runId}.json
backend reads run-state.json to display real-time story progress in UI (fallback when WAL events absent)
progress.txt still written as human-readable summary alongside run-state.json for compatibility
Migration: on first init, existing progress.txt converted to run-state.json format
UI: Run View shows 'Resumed from story N' indicator when resuming from run-state.json

userStories.title: Direction Stack ↔ CLAUDE.md Bi-Directional Sync
userStories.description: When Direction Stack L3 is updated in Rorca UI, propose a CLAUDE.md diff. When CLAUDE.md is edited externally, propose L3 updates. Uses AST-assisted semantic mapping (AST provides structure, LLM interprets layer assignment). Never silent overwrites.
acceptanceCriteria: When L3 direction layer updated in UI: backend generates CLAUDE.md diff via OpenCode, surfaces in Hub as 'Direction Stack updated — apply to CLAUDE.md?' with inline diff viewer
User can approve, reject, or edit the diff before it writes to disk
Chokidar file watcher on CLAUDE.md: detects external edits within 2s
On external CLAUDE.md edit: backend uses OpenCode to parse changed sections (AST structure + LLM semantic mapping), proposes L3 updates in Hub
AST parser (remark/unified) extracts heading tree and section content from CLAUDE.md
Section → layer mapping: LLM classifies each section as L1 (global principle), L2 (domain), L3 (project) with reasoning shown in proposal UI
Conflict detection: if both L3 and CLAUDE.md changed since last sync, show merge UI
Sync history stored in .rorca/memory/sync-log.json (timestamp, direction, diff, approved/rejected)
Never auto-write on managed:hybrid files — always require approval

userStories.title: Chokidar File Watcher — Real-Time Filesystem Sync
userStories.description: Backend daemon watches all registered context/intent files using chokidar. External edits (in VS Code, vim, etc.) are detected and surfaced in the Rorca UI within 2 seconds.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/src/lib/file-watcher.ts uses chokidar to watch all files in routing.global + all .rorca/ files
Change events debounced (300ms) before processing
On change: WAL event written (type: 'context_file_changed', payload: { path, managed, changeSize })
SSE pushes file change notification to connected UI clients instantly
UI shows toast: 'CLAUDE.md updated externally — syncing...' with file path and change summary
Watcher survives backend restarts (re-attaches on startup)
Watcher respects .gitignore — never watches node_modules, .git, dist/
File watcher disabled during Rorca-initiated writes (prevents echo events)
GET /api/workspace/file-watch-status returns watcher health and watched file list

userStories.title: Visual Rules Engine — Path Scope Editor in Settings
userStories.description: Settings UI for configuring the routing table visually. Users click a directory path and attach skills/contexts without writing JSON. The .rorca/config.json is the generated output.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings > Workspace Context > Rules Engine section
Directory tree browser showing workspace structure (expandable, lazy-loaded)
Click any directory → sidebar shows current injected skills for that path
Add/remove skills via dropdown (lists all .rorca/skills/*.md files)
Priority slider per scope rule (1–100)
Tag rules section: tag input + skill attachment (e.g., tag 'auth' → security.md)
Token budget slider with live token count preview
Changes update .rorca/config.json on save (not live — save button required)
JSON editor tab: raw edit of config.json with schema validation and inline errors
'Eject to Config' button for new workspaces: generates .rorca/config.json from current settings state — surfaces advanced options not shown in visual editor
Import/export config as JSON for team sharing

userStories.title: In-App Context File Editor
userStories.description: Full editor for all context/intent files directly in Rorca — no context switching to VS Code. Supports CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, all skill files, MEMORY.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings > Workspace Context > Files tab lists all registered context/intent files
Click any file → full Monaco editor opens inline (syntax: Markdown)
Word count + estimated token count shown in editor header
Diff view toggle: show changes vs last committed version (git diff)
managed:rorca files show 'Managed by Rorca' banner — edits allowed but warned they may be overwritten on next sync
managed:manual files editable freely
managed:hybrid files show proposed changes as diff, user accepts/rejects sections
Save writes directly to filesystem (triggers chokidar watcher, which debounces and skips echo)
Unsaved changes indicator + keyboard shortcut ⌘S to save
New file button: create new skill file in .rorca/skills/ with template

userStories.title: Workspace Health Dashboard
userStories.description: Visual health indicator showing context/intent completeness for the current workspace. Shown in Hub and in trigger modal before each run.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub shows 'Workspace Health' card: Context Richness Score (0–100%) with breakdown
Score components: CLAUDE.md (present + depth), AGENTS.md (present + roles defined), .rorca/config.json (present + scopes defined), MEMORY.md (present + entry count), skills (count of skill files)
Color coding: green (>80%), yellow (50–80%), red (<50%)
Each component shows specific suggestion: 'AGENTS.md missing — generate from directory structure'
Pipeline trigger modal shows compact health badge — warns if score < 50% before run
GET /api/workspace/:id/health returns full health report JSON
Health score recalculated on any file change (chokidar event triggers recalc)
Score history tracked in .rorca/memory/health-log.json — shows trend over time

userStories.title: Skill Library Management
userStories.description: Full management of .rorca/skills/ skill files — create, edit, delete, assign to scopes/tags. Skill files are the intent layer (The Ought) — behavioral methods for specific domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings > Workspace Context > Skills tab
Lists all .rorca/skills/*.md files with name, word count, assigned scopes/tags
Create new skill: name input + template selector (blank, testing, security, performance, database, API)
Edit skill: opens in-app editor (CIE-011)
Delete skill: warns if skill is assigned to active scope/tag rules
Skill usage indicator: how many stories injected this skill in last N runs
Import skill from URL (fetches markdown, saves to .rorca/skills/)
Export skill as shareable .md file
Skill templates: starter content for common domains (react.md, postgres.md, terraform.md, auth.md)
Skill preview: render Markdown in preview panel alongside editor

userStories.title: Post-Run Memory Synthesis
userStories.description: After each pipeline run completes, Rorca runs a synthesis pass to identify new patterns, decisions, and learnings. Proposes structured entries for MEMORY.md episodic ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggered automatically after pipeline run status changes to 'completed' or 'failed'
Synthesis uses OpenCode/Claude to review: story diffs (git log of run commits), failed story error messages, WAL events from the run
Generates proposed MEMORY.md entries: { date, category, title, rule, context, sourceStory }
Categories auto-detected: Bug Fix (from failed→passed patterns), Convention (from repeated patterns), Architecture (from structural changes), Gotcha (from error messages)
Proposed entries surfaced in Hub as 'Memory Updates' card within 60s of run completion
User reviews each proposal: Approve (writes to MEMORY.md) / Reject (logs to rejected.json) / Edit (inline edit before write)
Batch approve all button for uncontested entries
Synthesis result cached — user can dismiss and return to review later
Synthesis skipped for runs with 0 completed stories

userStories.title: Template System — Scaffold Templates for New Projects
userStories.description: Reusable scaffold template bundles that define the full context/intent file set for common project types. Shareable, importable, composable.
acceptanceCriteria: Built-in templates: Next.js SaaS, Express API, Python FastAPI, React Component Library, Monorepo (Turborepo), Blank
Each template bundle: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .rorca/config.json, skill files for detected stack
Template applied during rorca init or via Settings > Templates > Apply
Custom template creation: 'Export as Template' button in Settings — bundles current workspace config into importable .rorca-template.json
Template import: drag-and-drop or URL — imports and previews before applying
Templates stored in .rorca/templates/ — committed to repo for team sharing
Template versioning: bundle includes schemaVersion — Rorca warns on incompatible versions
Community templates: Settings shows a hardcoded curated list of starter templates (rorca.app/templates cloud fetch is post-cloud-launch; stub with empty list and 'Coming soon' note for now)
Template diff: when applying template to existing workspace, show what would change

userStories.title: Context Payload Preview — Token Budget Transparency
userStories.description: Before triggering a run, show the user exactly what context will be injected into each story and how many tokens it will consume. Full transparency into the routing engine's decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline trigger modal shows 'Context Preview' expandable section
Lists: global files (always injected), predicted scope matches (based on story path analysis), tag matches, estimated total tokens per story
Token bar visualization: global (blue) + scoped (green) + tagged (purple) = total vs budget
Warning if any story exceeds tokenBudget — shows which files were dropped
Per-story breakdown: click any story to see its specific predicted context payload
Context preview recalculates when spec or routing config changes
GET /api/pipeline/context-preview?specId=X returns full preview payload
After run: actual vs predicted context shown in Run View (did path prediction match reality?)

userStories.title: Monorepo Support — Multi-App Scope Detection
userStories.description: First-class support for monorepos (Turborepo, Nx, Lerna, pnpm workspaces). Each app in the monorepo gets its own scope with auto-detected skills.
acceptanceCriteria: Echolocation detects monorepo structure: turbo.json, nx.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, multiple package.json in apps/ or packages/
Auto-generates scope entry per detected app with appropriate skill files
Example: apps/web → react.md + tailwind.md, apps/api → node.md + postgres.md, packages/ui → react.md + storybook.md
AGENTS.md auto-generated with per-app agent roles
Monorepo root CLAUDE.md covers shared conventions; app-level overrides via scope injection
Cross-app story detection: if story touches multiple apps, both scopes injected (up to tokenBudget)
Visual Rules Engine shows monorepo tree structure for scope assignment

userStories.title: Context/Intent Engine Integration Tests
userStories.description: End-to-end tests verifying the routing engine, file watchers, memory synthesis, and scaffold generation work correctly together.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: rorca init on a Next.js fixture project produces correct scaffold files
Test: context-router correctly injects frontend skills for a story touching src/components/
Test: context-router drops lowest-priority scopes when token budget exceeded
Test: chokidar watcher detects external CLAUDE.md edit and fires correct WAL event
Test: memory synthesis proposes entries after a run with known bug-fix commits
Test: run-state.json written atomically after each story, correct resume from mid-run state
Test: .rorca/config.json schema validation rejects invalid glob patterns
Test: bi-directional sync generates correct CLAUDE.md diff when L3 updated
All tests use fixture workspaces in backend/src/__tests__/fixtures/
Tests run without requiring OpenCode or Claude CLI (mocked)
